Liam H: kicking off gradual deploy v3.1.0 -> 20%. deploy-bot grace_period=60s. spotting streaming p95 +15% in eu-west-1, gen routes OK. hold for quick triage?

deploy-bot: rollout v3.1.0 -> 20%. auto-revert scheduled if error_rate >1.2% for 60s.

Rina K: looks isolated to streaming. hypothesis: connection pooling change caused head-of-line delays. Marco, can we slice routing?

Marco D: yes. options: targeted rollback for streaming route OR pin enterprise pools. Targeted rollback cheaper. I'll apply route-slice now.

Liam H: do it. If auto-revert triggers globally, abort and do manual rollback. Keep customer comms ready.

Marco D: running: `redwoodctl route update streaming --slice global:eu-west-1 --version v3.0.7`

ops-bot: change applied. Incident INC-4339 created (reason: streaming p95 spike).

Rina K: telemetry improving in eu-west-1 after slice. No errors on other routes.

Liam H: decision: targeted route rollback executed, auto-revert suppressed by manual intervention. Action items: Marco to harden connection pool settings, Rina to add streaming smoke to preflight, ops to draft customer note.

Marco D: starting fix branch fix/stream-pool-window. ETA 40m.

Liam H: thanks. We'll keep thread open 30m and then resume rollout if stable.
